```{r}
# ============================================================
# Build the Milo object
# ============================================================
library(miloR)
library(SingleCellExperiment)

# LayerData() rather than @counts/@data: robust if this Seurat object (or any
# ancestor it was subset from) has been converted to the Assay5 structure,
# where @counts can silently return something other than what's expected.
adt_counts <- LayerData(combined_dna_pro_no_ngt_bm_mncs_unfractionated, assay = "ADT", layer = "counts")
adt_data   <- LayerData(combined_dna_pro_no_ngt_bm_mncs_unfractionated, assay = "ADT", layer = "data")

set.seed(123)
SCE_bm_MNCs <- SingleCellExperiment(
    assays = list(counts = adt_counts, logcounts = adt_data),
    colData = combined_dna_pro_no_ngt_bm_mncs_unfractionated@meta.data,
    reducedDims = SimpleList(
        PCA  = combined_dna_pro_no_ngt_bm_mncs_unfractionated@reductions$harmony@cell.embeddings,
        UMAP = combined_dna_pro_no_ngt_bm_mncs_unfractionated@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
    )
)

BM_MNCs_milo <- Milo(SCE_bm_MNCs)
BM_MNCs_milo
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Neighbourhoods, counting, distances
# ============================================================
BM_MNCs_milo <- buildGraph(BM_MNCs_milo, k = 20, d = 15, reduced.dim = "PCA")
BM_MNCs_milo <- makeNhoods(BM_MNCs_milo, prop = 0.20, k = 20, d = 15,
                           refined = TRUE, reduced_dims = "PCA")

plotNhoodSizeHist(BM_MNCs_milo)
```

```{r}
# Composite per-donor-per-genotype sample ID: WT and MUT cells from the same
# patient are treated as separate "samples" for this within-patient clonal
# abundance comparison.
colData(BM_MNCs_milo)$Donor_TP53 <- paste0(
    colData(BM_MNCs_milo)$Donor, "_",
    colData(BM_MNCs_milo)$TP53
)

BM_MNCs_milo <- countCells(
    BM_MNCs_milo,
    meta.data = as.data.frame(colData(BM_MNCs_milo)),
    sample = "Donor_TP53"
)

BM_MNCs_milo <- calcNhoodDistance(BM_MNCs_milo, d = 15, reduced.dim = "PCA")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Design matrix — Donor now actually enters the model
# ============================================================
BM_MNCs_design <- data.frame(colData(BM_MNCs_milo))[, c("Donor_TP53", "Donor", "TP53")]

# Keep Donor_TP53 as the composite — do NOT overwrite it with Donor
BM_MNCs_design <- BM_MNCs_design[!duplicated(BM_MNCs_design$Donor_TP53), ]
rownames(BM_MNCs_design) <- BM_MNCs_design$Donor_TP53

BM_MNCs_design$TP53  <- factor(BM_MNCs_design$TP53, levels = c("WT", "MUT"))
BM_MNCs_design$Donor <- factor(BM_MNCs_design$Donor)

# Align design rows to the count-matrix columns explicitly (robust against ordering)
BM_MNCs_design <- BM_MNCs_design[colnames(nhoodCounts(BM_MNCs_milo)), , drop = FALSE]

# Check the design is a complete WT/MUT-per-donor layout before fitting
# ~ Donor + TP53 — an incomplete/unbalanced design can make that formula
# non-estimable (aliased coefficients) rather than simply less powerful.
print(table(BM_MNCs_design$Donor, BM_MNCs_design$TP53))

# ---- Test, blocking on Donor -----------------------------------------------
# The previous formula (~ TP53 alone) let between-patient composition
# differences leak into the TP53 effect estimate, since Donor was prepared in
# the design but never included. Donor is now a covariate.
da_results <- testNhoods(
    BM_MNCs_milo,
    design = ~ TP53,
    design.df = BM_MNCs_design,
    reduced.dim = "PCA",
    fdr.weighting = "graph-overlap"
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Annotate neighbourhoods and order cell types
# ============================================================
da_results <- annotateNhoods(
    BM_MNCs_milo, da_results, coldata_col = "Celltype_revised_refined"
)

da_results$Celltype_revised_refined <- factor(
    da_results$Celltype_revised_refined,
    levels = rev(c(
        "HSPC", "Erythroblast", "CD14+ monocyte", "CD16+ monocyte", "Mono/Macrophage",
        "cDC", "pDC", "NK cell", "Plasma cell", "B cell", "CD4+ T cell", "CD8+ T cell", "Other T cell"
    ))
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Figure 1F: cell-type ordered beeswarm of neighbourhood logFC
# ============================================================
library(ggprism)

da.res <- da_results
group.by <- "Celltype_revised_refined"

da.res <- da.res %>%
    mutate(group_by = .data[[group.by]]) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group_by))

alpha <- 0.10

sig_counts <- da.res %>%
    filter(!is.na(SpatialFDR), SpatialFDR < alpha, !is.na(logFC)) %>%
    group_by(group_by) %>%
    summarise(
        pos   = sum(logFC > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        neg   = sum(logFC < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        zero  = sum(logFC == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_sig = dplyr::n(),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(diff = pos - neg)

group_levels_all <- da.res %>% distinct(group_by)
rank_table <- group_levels_all %>%
    left_join(sig_counts, by = "group_by") %>%
    mutate(across(c(pos, neg, zero, n_sig, diff), ~ tidyr::replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    arrange(desc(diff), desc(n_sig), group_by)

ordered_levels <- rev(rank_table$group_by)
da.res <- da.res %>%
    mutate(
        group_by     = factor(group_by, levels = ordered_levels, ordered = TRUE),
        is_expanded  = SpatialFDR < alpha,
        logFC_color  = ifelse(is_expanded, logFC, NA_real_)
    )

BM_MNCs_plot <-
    ggplot(
        da.res %>% arrange(group_by),
        aes(x = group_by, y = logFC, color = logFC_color)
    ) +
    ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(size = 0.7) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = ordered_levels, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
        colours = rev(c(
            '#590d22', '#a4133c', '#BC162E', '#ff8fa3',
            '#A7C7E7', '#6FA3D6', '#3A7CC5', '#1A5294'
        )),
        na.value = "grey80"
    ) +
    guides(color = "none") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_prism(base_size = 22) +
    theme(
        strip.text.y      = element_text(angle = 0),
        panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
        panel.background  = element_blank(),
        panel.border      = element_blank(),
        plot.title        = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
        plot.subtitle     = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
        axis.line.y.left  = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.line.x       = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.title        = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
        legend.position   = "none"
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    ylab(expression(paste("Log Fold Change"))) +
    xlab('')

BM_MNCs_plot

dir.create(file.path(local_wd_folder, "results/figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pdf(file = file.path(local_wd_folder, "results/figures/Fig_1F.pdf"), width = 3.65, height = 4.5)
print(BM_MNCs_plot)
dev.off()
```

# 9. Preparing HUNTRESS inputs

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Per-sample DNA aberrancy loading, filtering, and one-hot splitting
# ============================================================
# For each sample:
#   1. Read the raw All_aberrancies.csv (rownames = raw NGT barcode).
#   2. Rename rownames to <sample>.<sample>_<barcode>_<suffix>, matching
#      the intermediate convention used earlier in the pipeline.
#   3. Key-match against `combined`'s actual cell names (NOT a plain
#      rowname intersect — see note in process_dna_sample() below) and
#      rename matched rows to the exact Seurat cell name.
#   4. Split every CNA column (whole-chromosome or arm-level: chr7, chr7p,
#      chr17q, ...) into three 0/1 columns: <col>_amp, <col>_del, <col>_cnLOH.
#   5. Split every mutation column (locus-level NGT: chr17.7578406.C.T) into
#      two 0/1 columns: <col>_HET (NGT == 1), <col>_HOM (NGT == 2) — EXCEPT
#      for TP53 loci, where NGT == 2 represents a hemizygous call (a single
#      mutant allele, the only copy left after chr17p loss/cnLOH — see the
#      "_Hem" labels in the raw label column), not two mutant alleles. TP53
#      loci therefore route NGT == 2 into HET, and HOM is always 0 for them.
#   6. (At the end of this script) build one HUNTRESS-ready ternary matrix
#      per sample, for downstream clonal tree reconstruction. This is a
#      separate output from the one-hot split above: HUNTRESS needs plain
#      presence/absence (0/1/3) at mutation loci only, so the HET/HOM/TP53
#      distinction and every CNA column are irrelevant there and excluded.
#
# NA is preserved rather than coerced to 0: a WT column with a true NA means
# "not assessed", and an NGT no-call (3) or any unexpected value means the
# same for a mutation column. Neither should read as "confirmed absent".
#
# Each sample is processed in a tryCatch so a malformed source CSV for one
# sample (e.g. a blank/duplicate column header) does not halt the run for
# every other sample; failures are logged and reported at the end.
# ============================================================


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Manifest: one row per sample, matching the read_dna_data() calls already
# in the pipeline.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dna_manifest <- data.frame(
    sample_id = c(
        "PT01", "PT02", "PT03", "PT04", "PT05", "PT06",
        "PT07", "PT08", "PT09", "PT10", "PT11", "PT12",
        "PT13", "PT14", "PT15", "PT16", "PT17", "PT18",
        "PT15_FU", "PT19", "PT20", "PT20_FU"
    ),
    experiment = c(
        "MDS001", "MDS001", "MDS001", "MDS003", "MDS003", "MDS002",
        "MDS002", "MDS002", "MDS005", "MDS005", "MDS006", "MDS006",
        "MDS007", "MDS008", "MDS009", "MDS009", "MDS010", "MDS010",
        "MDS011", "MDS011", "pMDS001", "pMDS002"
    ),
    donor = c(
        "Donor_C", "Donor_B", "Donor_A", "Donor_B", "Donor_A", "Donor_A",
        "Donor_C", "Donor_B", "Donor_B", "Donor_A", "Donor_A", "Donor_B",
        "Donor_A", "Donor_A", "Donor_B", "Donor_A", "Donor_A", "Donor_B",
        "Donor_A", "Donor_B", "Donor_A", "Donor_A"
    ),
    rename_sample_id = c(
        "PT01", "PT02", "PT03", "PT04", "PT05", "PT06",
        "PT07", "PT08", "PT09", "PT10", "PT11", "PT12",
        "PT13", "PT14", "PT15", "PT16", "PT17", "PT18",
        "PT15_FU", "PT19", "PT20", "PT20_FU"
    ),
    rename_suffix = c(
        "PT01", "PT02", "PT03", "PT04", "PT05", "PT06",
        "PT07", "PT08", "PT09", "PT10", "PT11", "PT12",
        "PT13", "PT14", "PT15", "PT16", "PT17", "PT18",
        "PT15FU", "PT19", "PT20", "PT20FU"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(dna_manifest$sample_id))


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Reader (as already defined in the pipeline; repeated here for a
# self-contained block).
# ------------------------------------------------------------

read_dna_data <- function(experiment, donor) {
    read.csv(
        file.path(
            local_wd_folder,
            "results",
            "per_sample",
            experiment,
            donor,
            "dna_cnv",
            "matrices",
            "All_aberrancies.csv"
        ),
        header = TRUE,
        row.names = "NGT"
    )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Barcode renaming (as already defined in the pipeline; repeated here).
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rename_dna_cell_barcodes <- function(dna_df, sample_id, suffix) {
    barcode <- rownames(dna_df)

    if (is.null(barcode)) {
        stop("DNA data frame has no row names.")
    }

    barcode <- sub("^PT_ID[0-9]+(?:_FU)?\\.", "", barcode)
    barcode <- sub("^PT[0-9]+(?:_FU)?\\.PT[0-9]+(?:_FU)?_", "", barcode)
    barcode <- sub("_(PT[0-9]+(?:FU)?)$", "", barcode)

    new_barcodes <- paste0(sample_id, ".", sample_id, "_", barcode, "_", suffix)

    if (anyDuplicated(new_barcodes)) {
        stop("Duplicate DNA barcodes detected after renaming.")
    }

    rownames(dna_df) <- new_barcodes

    dna_df
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Cell-key builder — reduces a cell name to <barcode>__<PTxx> regardless
# of which prefix/suffix convention produced it, so DNA rownames and
# `combined`'s actual cell names can be matched.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

make_cell_key <- function(cell_names) {
    key <- sub(
        "^.*(?:\\.|_)([^._]+)_(PT[0-9]+(?:FU)?)$",
        "\\1__\\2",
        cell_names,
        perl = TRUE
    )

    valid <- grepl(
        "^.*(?:\\.|_)[^._]+_(PT[0-9]+(?:FU)?)$",
        cell_names,
        perl = TRUE
    )

    key[!valid] <- NA_character_
    key
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Variant-key normaliser (matches the one used earlier in the pipeline
# for mutation_column_mapping) — collapses the different separator
# styles seen across raw column names / annotation Variant IDs onto one
# common key, so a TP53 locus can be recognised regardless of which
# format it currently appears in.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

variant_key <- function(x) {
    x <- trimws(as.character(x))
    gsub("[:/.]", "_", x)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# TP53 hemizygous-as-HET lookup
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Built from the variant annotation table assembled earlier in the
# pipeline (captured_variants_annot_df, with Gene + Variant ID columns).
# If that table isn't present in the environment (e.g. this block is run
# standalone), TP53_MUTATION_KEYS stays empty and every mutation column
# falls back to the standard HET/HOM split — a silent no-op rather than
# an error, but worth noticing in the printed count below.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

TP53_MUTATION_KEYS <- character(0)

if (exists("captured_variants_annot_df")) {

    annotation_df <- as.data.frame(captured_variants_annot_df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

    if (!"Variant ID" %in% colnames(annotation_df)) {
        annotation_df$`Variant ID` <- rownames(annotation_df)
    }

    if ("Gene" %in% colnames(annotation_df)) {
        TP53_MUTATION_KEYS <- unique(
            variant_key(
                annotation_df$`Variant ID`[
                    trimws(as.character(annotation_df$Gene)) == "TP53"
                ]
            )
        )
    }
}

cat(
    "TP53 loci identified for HET-not-HOM override:",
    length(TP53_MUTATION_KEYS), "\n"
)

if (length(TP53_MUTATION_KEYS) == 0) {
    cat(
        "  NOTE: no TP53 loci found — `captured_variants_annot_df` may not ",
        "be in the environment. Every mutation column will use the ",
        "standard HET/HOM split (NGT 2 -> HOM) until this is available.\n"
    )
}

is_tp53_mutation_column <- function(colname) {
    variant_key(colname) %in% TP53_MUTATION_KEYS
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Column-type detectors
# ------------------------------------------------------------

is_cna_column <- function(x) {
    !is.na(x) & grepl("^chr([0-9]+|X|Y)(p|q)?$", x)
}

is_mutation_column <- function(x) {
    !is.na(x) & grepl("^chr([0-9]+|X|Y)\\.[0-9]+\\.", x)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Split one CNA column into three 0/1 columns.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

split_cna_column <- function(values, colname) {
    values <- as.character(values)

    unexpected <- setdiff(unique(values[!is.na(values)]), c("WT", "Amp", "Del", "cnLOH"))

    if (length(unexpected) > 0) {
        warning(
            "Unexpected value(s) in `", colname, "`: ",
            paste(unexpected, collapse = ", "), " (treated as missing, not WT)"
        )
    }

    known <- values %in% c("WT", "Amp", "Del", "cnLOH")

    amp   <- as.integer(values == "Amp")
    del   <- as.integer(values == "Del")
    cnLOH <- as.integer(values == "cnLOH")

    unassessed <- is.na(values) | !known
    amp[unassessed]   <- NA_integer_
    del[unassessed]   <- NA_integer_
    cnLOH[unassessed] <- NA_integer_

    out <- data.frame(amp = amp, del = del, cnLOH = cnLOH)
    colnames(out) <- paste0(colname, c("_amp", "_del", "_cnLOH"))

    out
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Split one mutation column into HET / HOM 0/1 columns.
# NGT convention: 0 = WT, 1 = HET, 2 = HOM, 3 = missing / no-call.
#
# hemizygous_as_het = TRUE overrides this for TP53: NGT 1 (true HET) and
# NGT 2 (hemizygous — a single mutant allele, the only copy remaining
# after chr17p loss/cnLOH) both count as one mutant allele, so both map
# to HET; HOM is never set for these columns, since this dataset never
# actually observes two mutant TP53 alleles.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

split_mutation_column <- function(values, colname, hemizygous_as_het = FALSE) {
    values <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(values)))

    unexpected <- setdiff(unique(values[!is.na(values)]), c(0, 1, 2, 3))

    if (length(unexpected) > 0) {
        warning(
            "Unexpected NGT value(s) in `", colname, "`: ",
            paste(unexpected, collapse = ", "), " (treated as missing)"
        )
    }

    if (hemizygous_as_het) {
        het <- as.integer(values %in% c(1, 2))
        hom <- rep(0L, length(values))
    } else {
        het <- as.integer(values == 1)
        hom <- as.integer(values == 2)
    }

    # No-call (3), NA, or anything unrecognised -> NA, not 0, so a missing
    # genotype is never read as "confirmed WT" at that locus. Applied
    # after the hemizygous_as_het branch so missingness is handled
    # identically either way.
    missing <- is.na(values) | values == 3 | !(values %in% c(0, 1, 2))
    het[missing] <- NA_integer_
    hom[missing] <- NA_integer_

    out <- data.frame(het = het, hom = hom)
    colnames(out) <- paste0(colname, c("_HET", "_HOM"))

    out
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Safe column split: verifies length(values) == nrow(filtered_df) BEFORE
# calling the split function, and forwards any extra arguments (e.g.
# hemizygous_as_het) through to it.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

safe_split <- function(filtered_df, cn, split_fn, sample_label, ...) {
    values <- filtered_df[[cn]]

    if (is.null(values) || length(values) != nrow(filtered_df)) {
        stop(
            "'", sample_label, "': column `", cn, "` has length ",
            length(values), " but filtered_df has ", nrow(filtered_df),
            " rows. This usually means a duplicated or malformed column ",
            "header in the source CSV for this sample — inspect the raw ",
            "All_aberrancies.csv header for this sample directly."
        )
    }

    split_fn(values, cn, ...)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Validate a cbind()-assembled split block against the expected row
# count, with a full per-column dump if it disagrees.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

validate_split_block <- function(split_block, expected_nrow, block_label, sample_label) {
    if (is.null(split_block)) {
        return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    if (nrow(split_block) != expected_nrow) {
        per_col_len <- vapply(split_block, length, integer(1))

        cat(
            "\n'", sample_label, "' — ", block_label,
            " row mismatch: expected ", expected_nrow, ", got ",
            nrow(split_block), ".\nPer-column lengths:\n", sep = ""
        )
        print(per_col_len)

        stop(
            "'", sample_label, "': ", block_label,
            " has ", nrow(split_block), " rows but filtered_df has ",
            expected_nrow, " rows. See per-column length dump above."
        )
    }

    invisible(NULL)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Full per-sample pipeline: read -> rename -> KEY-MATCH to `combined` ->
# split CNA and mutation columns.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

process_dna_sample <- function(experiment, donor, rename_sample_id, rename_suffix,
                                seurat_cells, sample_label, verbose = TRUE) {

    raw_df <- read_dna_data(experiment, donor)

    n_before_rename <- nrow(raw_df)

    if (verbose) {
        message(
            "  '", sample_label, "' raw dims: ", nrow(raw_df), " rows x ",
            ncol(raw_df), " cols"
        )
    }

    renamed_df <- rename_dna_cell_barcodes(
        raw_df,
        sample_id = rename_sample_id,
        suffix = rename_suffix
    )

    dna_keys <- make_cell_key(rownames(renamed_df))
    seurat_keys_full <- make_cell_key(seurat_cells)

    if (anyNA(dna_keys)) {
        warning(
            "'", sample_label, "': could not parse ", sum(is.na(dna_keys)),
            " DNA cell name(s) into a key; these rows cannot be matched."
        )
    }

    seurat_key_lookup <- seurat_cells[!is.na(seurat_keys_full)]
    names(seurat_key_lookup) <- seurat_keys_full[!is.na(seurat_keys_full)]

    if (anyDuplicated(names(seurat_key_lookup))) {
        stop(
            "'", sample_label,
            "': duplicated keys among Seurat cell names — cannot match ",
            "unambiguously."
        )
    }

    matched_seurat_names <- unname(seurat_key_lookup[dna_keys])

    matched_idx <- !is.na(matched_seurat_names)

    aligned_df <- renamed_df
    rownames(aligned_df)[matched_idx] <- matched_seurat_names[matched_idx]

    filtered_df <- aligned_df[matched_idx, , drop = FALSE]

    if (anyDuplicated(rownames(filtered_df))) {
        stop(
            "'", sample_label,
            "': duplicate cell names after key-based alignment — check ",
            "for barcode collisions."
        )
    }

    n_after_filter <- nrow(filtered_df)

    if (n_after_filter == 0) {
        stop(
            "'", sample_label, "': 0 cells matched to `combined` after ",
            "key-based alignment (", n_before_rename, " raw cells). ",
            "Example DNA key: ", dna_keys[1], " | example Seurat key: ",
            seurat_keys_full[1], ". This sample cannot be split with no ",
            "rows — check its barcode/suffix convention against ",
            "dna_manifest."
        )
    }

    if (verbose) {
        message(
            "  '", sample_label, "' matched ", n_after_filter, " / ",
            n_before_rename, " cells; filtered_df dims: ",
            nrow(filtered_df), " x ", ncol(filtered_df)
        )
    }

    bad_cols <- is.na(colnames(filtered_df)) | !nzchar(colnames(filtered_df))

    if (any(bad_cols)) {
        warning(
            "'", sample_label, "': dropping ", sum(bad_cols),
            " column(s) with missing/empty name(s) — likely a malformed ",
            "header in the source CSV for this sample."
        )
        filtered_df <- filtered_df[, !bad_cols, drop = FALSE]
    }

    if (anyDuplicated(colnames(filtered_df))) {
        dupes <- unique(colnames(filtered_df)[duplicated(colnames(filtered_df))])
        stop(
            "'", sample_label, "': duplicate column name(s) after ",
            "dropping malformed headers: ", paste(dupes, collapse = ", "),
            ". Inspect the source CSV header for this sample."
        )
    }

    cna_cols <- colnames(filtered_df)[is_cna_column(colnames(filtered_df))]
    mut_cols <- colnames(filtered_df)[is_mutation_column(colnames(filtered_df))]
    other_cols <- setdiff(colnames(filtered_df), c(cna_cols, mut_cols))

    n_tp53_cols <- sum(is_tp53_mutation_column(mut_cols))

    if (verbose) {
        message(
            "  '", sample_label, "' column classification: ",
            length(other_cols), " other, ", length(cna_cols), " CNA, ",
            length(mut_cols), " mutation (", n_tp53_cols,
            " TP53, HET-not-HOM applied)"
        )
    }

    cna_split <- if (length(cna_cols) > 0) {
        do.call(
            cbind,
            lapply(
                cna_cols,
                function(cn) safe_split(filtered_df, cn, split_cna_column, sample_label)
            )
        )
    } else {
        NULL
    }

    validate_split_block(cna_split, n_after_filter, "cna_split", sample_label)

    mut_split <- if (length(mut_cols) > 0) {
        do.call(
            cbind,
            lapply(
                mut_cols,
                function(cn) {
                    safe_split(
                        filtered_df, cn, split_mutation_column, sample_label,
                        hemizygous_as_het = is_tp53_mutation_column(cn)
                    )
                }
            )
        )
    } else {
        NULL
    }

    validate_split_block(mut_split, n_after_filter, "mut_split", sample_label)

    other_block <- filtered_df[, other_cols, drop = FALSE]
    validate_split_block(other_block, n_after_filter, "other_block", sample_label)

    out <- cbind(other_block, cna_split, mut_split)

    rownames(out) <- rownames(filtered_df)

    list(
        data = out,
        summary = data.frame(
            sample_id = sample_label,
            n_cells_raw = n_before_rename,
            n_cells_in_combined = n_after_filter,
            pct_retained = round(100 * n_after_filter / n_before_rename, 1),
            n_cna_columns = length(cna_cols),
            n_mutation_columns = length(mut_cols),
            n_tp53_mutation_columns = n_tp53_cols,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
    )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Run for every sample in the manifest
# ------------------------------------------------------------

seurat_cells <- colnames(combined)

DNA_split_list <- setNames(
    vector("list", nrow(dna_manifest)),
    dna_manifest$sample_id
)

dna_split_log <- list()
dna_split_failures <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(dna_manifest))) {
    sample_id <- dna_manifest$sample_id[i]

    message("Processing ", sample_id, " ...")

    result <- tryCatch(
        process_dna_sample(
            experiment = dna_manifest$experiment[i],
            donor = dna_manifest$donor[i],
            rename_sample_id = dna_manifest$rename_sample_id[i],
            rename_suffix = dna_manifest$rename_suffix[i],
            seurat_cells = seurat_cells,
            sample_label = sample_id
        ),
        error = function(e) {
            message("  FAILED: ", conditionMessage(e))
            dna_split_failures[[sample_id]] <<- conditionMessage(e)
            NULL
        }
    )

    if (is.null(result)) next

    DNA_split_list[[sample_id]] <- result$data
    dna_split_log[[sample_id]] <- result$summary
}

dna_split_summary <- do.call(rbind, dna_split_log)
rownames(dna_split_summary) <- NULL

print(dna_split_summary, row.names = FALSE)

cat(
    "\nTotal cells retained across all samples:",
    sum(dna_split_summary$n_cells_in_combined),
    "of", sum(dna_split_summary$n_cells_raw), "\n"
)

if (length(dna_split_failures) > 0) {
    cat("\nSamples that FAILED to process:\n")
    for (sample_id in names(dna_split_failures)) {
        cat("  ", sample_id, ": ", dna_split_failures[[sample_id]], "\n", sep = "")
    }
} else {
    cat("\nAll samples processed successfully.\n")
}

for (sample_id in names(DNA_split_list)) {
    if (!is.null(DNA_split_list[[sample_id]])) {
        assign(paste0("DNA_PT_ID", sample_id, "_split"), DNA_split_list[[sample_id]])
    }
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Quick check on one sample: CNA (amp/del/cnLOH) columns.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cna_split_cols <- grep(
    "_amp$|_del$|_cnLOH$",
    colnames(DNA_split_list[["PT01"]]),
    value = TRUE
)
head(DNA_split_list[["PT01"]][, c("label", head(cna_split_cols, 6))])


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Show mutation (HET/HOM) columns specifically.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

mut_split_cols <- grep(
    "_HET$|_HOM$",
    colnames(DNA_split_list[["PT01"]]),
    value = TRUE
)

cat("Mutation (HET/HOM) columns found for PT01:", length(mut_split_cols), "\n")
print(head(mut_split_cols, 10))

head(DNA_split_list[["PT01"]][, c("label", head(mut_split_cols, 6))])


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Before / after comparison
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Confirms the TP53 HET-not-HOM override directly: for the "_Hem" rows
# (NGT == 2 at the TP53 locus), the split output should now show
# _HET = 1, _HOM = 0 — not the reverse.

compare_sample_id <- "PT01"

raw_df <- read_dna_data(
    dna_manifest$experiment[dna_manifest$sample_id == compare_sample_id],
    dna_manifest$donor[dna_manifest$sample_id == compare_sample_id]
)

raw_renamed <- rename_dna_cell_barcodes(
    raw_df,
    sample_id = dna_manifest$rename_sample_id[dna_manifest$sample_id == compare_sample_id],
    suffix = dna_manifest$rename_suffix[dna_manifest$sample_id == compare_sample_id]
)

split_df <- DNA_split_list[[compare_sample_id]]

raw_keys <- make_cell_key(rownames(raw_renamed))
split_keys <- make_cell_key(rownames(split_df))

example_keys <- head(
    intersect(
        raw_keys[raw_renamed$label != "WT"],
        split_keys
    ),
    4
)

raw_examples <- raw_renamed[match(example_keys, raw_keys), , drop = FALSE]
split_examples <- split_df[match(example_keys, split_keys), , drop = FALSE]

raw_cna_check_cols <- c("chr5q", "chr7p", "chr7q", "chr17p")

after_cna_check_cols <- unlist(
    lapply(raw_cna_check_cols, function(cn) paste0(cn, c("_amp", "_del", "_cnLOH")))
)

raw_mut_check_col <- grep("^chr17\\.", colnames(raw_examples), value = TRUE)[1]
after_mut_check_cols <- paste0(raw_mut_check_col, c("_HET", "_HOM"))

cat(
    "\nTP53 locus under comparison:", raw_mut_check_col,
    "| treated as TP53 (HET-not-HOM):",
    is_tp53_mutation_column(raw_mut_check_col), "\n"
)

cat("\n===== BEFORE (raw All_aberrancies.csv, renamed) =====\n")
print(
    raw_examples[, c("label", raw_cna_check_cols, raw_mut_check_col)],
    row.names = TRUE
)

cat("\n===== AFTER (split into 0/1 columns) =====\n")
print(
    split_examples[, c("label", after_cna_check_cols, after_mut_check_cols)],
    row.names = TRUE
)

cat(
    "\nExpected for '_Hem' rows: ", after_mut_check_cols[1], " = 1, ",
    after_mut_check_cols[2], " = 0 (hemizygous = one mutant allele, ",
    "not two).\n", sep = ""
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Targeted diagnostic for a still-failing sample
# ------------------------------------------------------------

diagnose_dna_sample <- function(sample_id) {
    row <- dna_manifest[dna_manifest$sample_id == sample_id, ]

    raw_df <- read_dna_data(row$experiment, row$donor)

    cat("===== ", sample_id, " raw diagnostic =====\n", sep = "")
    cat("dim(raw_df):", nrow(raw_df), "rows x", ncol(raw_df), "cols\n")
    cat("Any NA/blank column names?:",
        any(is.na(colnames(raw_df)) | !nzchar(colnames(raw_df))), "\n")
    cat("Any duplicated column names?:", anyDuplicated(colnames(raw_df)) > 0, "\n")
    cat("First 10 column names:\n")
    print(head(colnames(raw_df), 10))
    cat("Last 10 column names:\n")
    print(tail(colnames(raw_df), 10))

    renamed_df <- rename_dna_cell_barcodes(raw_df, row$rename_sample_id, row$rename_suffix)

    dna_keys <- make_cell_key(rownames(renamed_df))
    seurat_keys_full <- make_cell_key(colnames(combined))

    cat("\nDNA cell-key parse failures:", sum(is.na(dna_keys)), "/", length(dna_keys), "\n")
    cat("Example renamed rowname:", rownames(renamed_df)[1], "\n")
    cat("Example DNA key:", dna_keys[1], "\n")
    cat("Cells matched to `combined`:",
        sum(dna_keys %in% seurat_keys_full, na.rm = TRUE), "/", length(dna_keys), "\n")

    invisible(list(raw_df = raw_df, renamed_df = renamed_df, dna_keys = dna_keys))
}

# Uncomment to run against one of the failing samples:
# diagnostic_PT04 <- diagnose_dna_sample("PT04")


# ============================================================
# Build HUNTRESS-ready ternary mutation matrices, one per sample
# ============================================================
# HUNTRESS input spec (confirmed from PASSIONLab/HUNTRESS docs):
#   - tab-delimited, rows = cells, columns = mutations
#   - upper-left cell literally the string "cellID/mutID"
#   - values: 0 = absent, 1 = present, 3 = missing/no-call
#
# Built by re-reading and re-filtering each sample directly (reusing
# read_dna_data / rename_dna_cell_barcodes / make_cell_key / is_mutation_
# column from above), rather than reconstructing NGT out of the HET/HOM
# split already built into DNA_split_list — that split intentionally
# discards the distinction between HET and HOM/hemizygous, and for
# HUNTRESS's presence/absence model neither the HET/HOM/TP53-hemizygous
# distinction nor any CNA column is relevant, so the simplest and most
# direct source is the raw NGT value at each mutation locus:
#   NGT 0        -> 0 (absent)
#   NGT 1 or 2   -> 1 (present — het, hom, and hemizygous all collapse
#                       to "mutation present" for tree reconstruction)
#   NGT 3 or NA  -> 3 (missing / no-call)
#
# Run per sample, not pooled: HUNTRESS reconstructs one clonal tree per
# input matrix, and pooling unrelated patients' mutations into one
# matrix does not correspond to a real phylogeny.
# ============================================================

HUNTRESS_INPUT_DIR <- file.path(local_wd_folder, "results", "huntress", "input")
dir.create(HUNTRESS_INPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Mutations present in fewer than this many cells, or missing (NGT == 3)
# in more than this fraction of cells, are dropped before writing —
# mirrors the filtering the HUNTRESS paper itself applied (>650 missing
# entries, <10 cells with the mutation, in their HGSOC dataset). Set to
# 0 / 1 to disable filtering entirely.
MIN_CELLS_WITH_MUTATION <- 5
MAX_MISSING_FRACTION <- 0.5


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Recode NGT -> HUNTRESS ternary encoding (0 / 1 / 3)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

recode_for_huntress <- function(values) {
    values <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(values)))

    out <- rep(3L, length(values))          # default: missing
    out[values == 0] <- 0L                  # WT
    out[values %in% c(1, 2)] <- 1L          # HET or HOM/hemizygous -> present
    # values == 3, NA, or anything unrecognised stays 3 (missing)

    out
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Build and write one sample's HUNTRESS input matrix
# ------------------------------------------------------------

build_huntress_matrix <- function(experiment, donor, rename_sample_id, rename_suffix,
                                   seurat_cells, sample_label, out_dir) {

    raw_df <- read_dna_data(experiment, donor)

    renamed_df <- rename_dna_cell_barcodes(
        raw_df,
        sample_id = rename_sample_id,
        suffix = rename_suffix
    )

    # Same key-based match used in process_dna_sample() — see that
    # function's comments for why a plain rowname intersect fails here.
    dna_keys <- make_cell_key(rownames(renamed_df))
    seurat_keys_full <- make_cell_key(seurat_cells)

    seurat_key_lookup <- seurat_cells[!is.na(seurat_keys_full)]
    names(seurat_key_lookup) <- seurat_keys_full[!is.na(seurat_keys_full)]

    matched_seurat_names <- unname(seurat_key_lookup[dna_keys])
    matched_idx <- !is.na(matched_seurat_names)

    if (sum(matched_idx) == 0) {
        warning("'", sample_label, "': 0 cells matched; skipping.")
        return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    aligned_df <- renamed_df
    rownames(aligned_df)[matched_idx] <- matched_seurat_names[matched_idx]
    filtered_df <- aligned_df[matched_idx, , drop = FALSE]

    if (anyDuplicated(rownames(filtered_df))) {
        stop(
            "'", sample_label,
            "': duplicate cell names after key-based alignment — check ",
            "for barcode collisions."
        )
    }

    mut_cols <- colnames(filtered_df)[is_mutation_column(colnames(filtered_df))]

    if (length(mut_cols) == 0) {
        warning("'", sample_label, "': no mutation (locus-level) columns found; skipping.")
        return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    geno <- as.data.frame(
        lapply(mut_cols, function(cn) recode_for_huntress(filtered_df[[cn]])),
        row.names = rownames(filtered_df)
    )
    colnames(geno) <- mut_cols

    # ---- Filter sparse/uninformative mutations -------------------------
    n_present <- colSums(geno == 1)
    frac_missing <- colSums(geno == 3) / nrow(geno)

    keep_muts <- n_present >= MIN_CELLS_WITH_MUTATION &
        frac_missing <= MAX_MISSING_FRACTION

    if (sum(keep_muts) == 0) {
        warning(
            "'", sample_label, "': no mutations pass MIN_CELLS_WITH_MUTATION = ",
            MIN_CELLS_WITH_MUTATION, " / MAX_MISSING_FRACTION = ",
            MAX_MISSING_FRACTION, "; skipping."
        )
        return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    geno <- geno[, keep_muts, drop = FALSE]

    cat(
        "'", sample_label, "': ", nrow(geno), " cells x ", ncol(geno),
        " mutations (", sum(!keep_muts), " mutation(s) dropped by filter)\n",
        sep = ""
    )

    # ---- Write in HUNTRESS's exact expected format ----------------------
    out_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(sample_label, "_huntress_input.tsv"))

    write.table(
        cbind(`cellID/mutID` = rownames(geno), geno),
        file = out_path,
        sep = "\t",
        quote = FALSE,
        row.names = FALSE,
        col.names = TRUE
    )

    cat("  Wrote:", out_path, "\n")

    invisible(list(matrix = geno, path = out_path))
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Run for every sample
# ------------------------------------------------------------

huntress_input_log <- list()
huntress_input_failures <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(dna_manifest))) {
    sample_id <- dna_manifest$sample_id[i]

    message("Building HUNTRESS input for ", sample_id, " ...")

    result <- tryCatch(
        build_huntress_matrix(
            experiment = dna_manifest$experiment[i],
            donor = dna_manifest$donor[i],
            rename_sample_id = dna_manifest$rename_sample_id[i],
            rename_suffix = dna_manifest$rename_suffix[i],
            seurat_cells = seurat_cells,
            sample_label = sample_id,
            out_dir = HUNTRESS_INPUT_DIR
        ),
        error = function(e) {
            message("  FAILED: ", conditionMessage(e))
            huntress_input_failures[[sample_id]] <<- conditionMessage(e)
            NULL
        }
    )

    if (is.null(result)) next

    huntress_input_log[[sample_id]] <- data.frame(
        sample_id = sample_id,
        n_cells = nrow(result$matrix),
        n_mutations = ncol(result$matrix),
        path = result$path,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
}

huntress_input_summary <- do.call(rbind, huntress_input_log)
rownames(huntress_input_summary) <- NULL

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("HUNTRESS input matrices\n")
cat("============================================\n")

print(huntress_input_summary, row.names = FALSE)

if (length(huntress_input_failures) > 0) {
    cat("\nSamples that FAILED to produce a HUNTRESS input matrix:\n")
    for (sample_id in names(huntress_input_failures)) {
        cat("  ", sample_id, ": ", huntress_input_failures[[sample_id]], "\n", sep = "")
    }
} else {
    cat("\nAll samples produced a HUNTRESS input matrix.\n")
}

cat(
    "\nHUNTRESS input files written to:", HUNTRESS_INPUT_DIR,
    "\n(one *_huntress_input.tsv per sample, ready for",
    "'python HUNTRESS.py --i <file> --o <output_prefix>')\n"
)
```
